text: Bearing: Creating a favorable impression, appearance.

text: Courage: Mental quality that recognizes fear of danger and criticism.

text: There are 14 Marine Corps leadership traits.
q: How many leadership traits are there?

text: General Order 1: To take charge of this post and all government property in view.
q: What is General Order 1?
a: To take charge of this post and all government property in view.

text: General Order 2: To walk my post in a military manner, keeping always on the alert and observing everything that takes place within sight or hearing.
q: What is General Order 2?
a: To walk my post in a military manner, keeping always on the alert and observing everything that takes place within sight or hearing.

text: General Order 3: To report all violations of orders I am instructed to enforce.
q: What is General Order 3?
a: To report all violations of orders I am instructed to enforce.

text: General Order 4: To repeat all calls from posts more distant from the guardhouse than my own.
q: What is General Order 4?
a: To repeat all calls from posts more distant from the guardhouse than my own.

text: General Order 5: To quit my post only when properly relieved.
q: What is General Order 5?
a: To quit my post only when properly relieved.

text: General Order 6: To receive, obey and pass on to the sentry who relieves me, all orders from the Commanding Officer, Officer of the Day, and Officers and Non-Commissioned Officers of the guard only.
q: What is General Order 6?
a: To receive, obey and pass on to the sentry who relieves me, all orders from the Commanding Officer, Officer of the Day, and Officers and Non-Commissioned Officers of the guard only.

text: General Order 7: To talk to no one except in the line of duty.
q: What is General Order 7?
a: To talk to no one except in the line of duty.

text: General Order 8: To give the alarm in case of fire or disorder.
q: What is General Order 8?
a: To give the alarm in case of fire or disorder.

text: General Order 9: To call the Corporal of the Guard in any case not covered by instructions.
q: What is General Order 9?
a: To call the Corporal of the Guard in any case not covered by instructions.

text: General Order 10: To salute all officers and all colors and standards not cased.
q: What is General Order 10?
a: To salute all officers and all colors and standards not cased.

text: General Order 11: To be especially watchful at night and during the time for challenging, to challenge all persons on or near my post, and to allow no one to pass without proper authority.
q: What is General Order 11?
a: To be especially watchful at night and during the time for challenging, to challenge all persons on or near my post, and to allow no one to pass without proper authority.
